summary.text: Hair Mistress is Snowy Mountain blessed land's ninth peak lord, a rank six Gu Immortal with striking blue hair who confronts five Central Continent Gu Immortals in her hall.

claims.text: She lies on a cloud bed in a silk dress. Her appearance is ordinary, but her blue hair is like a river from her head down the bed. Bu Zhen Zi names her. She tells Zhao Lian Yun that Ma Hong Yun is not at her peak and that the first peak has Lady Wan Shou and Old Ancestor Xue Hu. She claims she will not die for Xue Hu, that he forced the peak lords to gather immortal materials, and that discord already exists among Snowy Mountain’s members. She says a super Gu formation, arranged by Sun Ming Lu, uses the peak lords as cores, lets rank six cultivation display rank seven strength here, and suppresses invaders. Mu Ling Lan’s water wave is blocked by a strand of hair turned into a dam. She then sends her blue hair to entangle the five, wrapping Shi Zheng Yi and Yu Yi Ye Zi into cocoons.
She lies on a cloud bed in a silk dress. Her appearance is ordinary, but her blue hair is extremely eye-catching, like a river that flows from her head down the cloud bed and covers its surface.

The five are wrapped like cocoons. She names the move blue hair constriction, says it grows stronger the longer it runs, and that she has kept it active since Old Ancestor Xue Hu began refining fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu. Yu Yi Ye Zi’s earth furnace fire cannot burn a strand. Bu Zhen Zi, a phantom path Gu Immortal, passes through the cocoons and frees the others. Even against five she is not at a disadvantage until Mu Ling Lan’s water wolves break her hair wall. She curls remaining hair into a ball that absorbs and releases energy. Bu Zhen Zi turns Mu Ling Lan’s water snake into phantom so it passes the ball; it turns solid, breaks her second defensive killer move, and pierces her heart. Her soul escapes her body. The hair ball detonates, shooting short hairs like arrows. The five concentrate on defending and let her soul escape. Shi Zheng Yi, excited, says she is dead, with only her soul left. The five cannot leave the ninth peak’s super Gu formation.

They say that when they killed her, her body and immortal aperture turned into ashes and disappeared. They guess that although her soul escaped, it must have already dispersed because of the formation.
